technical.summary: Mixed bullish technicals with strong moving average structure and recent reversal signals, but weak trend confirmation, overbought oscillators, and negative money flow limit conviction for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: CB shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 70 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support for conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (396.64), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and negative macro score (-4) create severely unfavourable conditions; 70-day earnings window adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Hull flip, MACD crossover, and three white soldiers provide technical reversal signals in extreme fear (10/100 VIX) contrarian setup with support at 195.22 nearby.
